name: What common storm conditions cause drywall water damage across the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: What common storm conditions cause drywall water damage across the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Severe Front Range hailstorms and wind-driven rain frequently compromise roofing flashing, vents, and siding, forcing moisture into attic spaces and upper walls. In communities like Denver, Parker, Centennial, and Greenwood Village, summer cloudbursts and winter freeze-thaw cycles stress exterior seals. When roof drainage or gutters overflow, water pools in attics and drips directly through ceiling drywall. Identifying this external entry point prevents newly hung sheetrock from experiencing recurrent water damage during the next seasonal storm cycle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Heavy hail, wind-driven rain, and freeze-thaw snowmelt compromise flashing and gutters, causing water to pool in attics and soak through interior ceilings and walls.
